title: LLM Finance Framework v0.9: 60-session backtest of Claude Haiku 5.5 (model outputs)
description: Every model call of the 60-session backtest described in the v0.9 paper of the LLM Finance Framework: Claude Haiku 5.5 through Claude Code, New York sessions from 2026-08-10 to 2026-11-02, one decision per session at 15:30 with fills at the 16:00 close, on SPY and AAPL, four LLM arms and two control arms. The SQLite database holds prompts, raw answers, parsed decisions, reflections and paper portfolios. Yahoo Finance prices are not included; a script rebuilds them with the framework code and checks 604 checksums.
